name: tracker-launch-host-command-deadline
goal: Keep Tracker dispatch moving when a host command stops producing child-process completion callbacks.

evidence: Primary launcher stalled after #953 wrote its startup receipt. The parent retained an unreaped child while HTTP and peer ticks continued. The host command Promise relies on the child callback even on timeout or cancellation; restarting the same binary restored dispatch.

The existing host process contract covered normal exit, rejected binaries and pre-abort, but omitted an in-flight command with a missing completion callback. Strengthen that case for both timeout and cancellation.
14bdaf0583 failed as expected: 'host command still pending' on in-flight abort without a completion callback.
Expire or cancel the host command independently of child completion, release streams and signal listeners, and keep the existing dispatch reservation and receipt checks.
The same case passes at a27aa5716b using the identical fixture, command and environment. Timeout and abort both reject without a child callback.
